text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both rallying—ETH up 5.2% is outpacing BTC's 3.3% gain—suggesting selective strength in altcoins despite extreme fear readings. The Fear & Greed index at 25 indicates panic-driven selling pressure still dominates, yet the 24-hour volume of $77B and rising sentiment over the past week hint that some accumulation is occurring into the dip. Bitcoin dominance holding at 56.4% while smaller caps gain suggests money is rotating cautiously rather than fleeing risk entirely.
